timing_protocol: Serial model documents on saved frozen OCR; no explicit warmup, cache clearing, or controlled machine-load benchmark.
early_overlap: The first family ran while CORD shards were prepared, CORD validation OCR was evaluated, and deterministic tests were run on the same Apple M1 Mac. Later model workloads are serialized.
failure_policy: Completed failures remain in the completion ledger and scoring denominators. No timeout increase, prompt adjustment, selective retry, or default promotion based on test observations.
interpretation: Fresh model extraction quality under the recorded local constraints; timings are exploratory and exclude new OCR, PDF parsing, and reviewer wait.
